chitchat: Rue builds three drinks at once without looking at any of them, watching the floor instead.
"Rule of the house: you can outrun the bass, you can't outrun the tab."
She racks a row of glasses under the ice-light and they come up glowing.
description: Rue works the ice-ribbon bar like a control desk, six things going at once and none of them spilling. Backlit from below, she's all silhouette and quick hands, a comms bud in one ear feeding her the night — who's flush, who's cut off, who's about to be a problem. She'll make you anything on the board and read exactly how your night is going from what you order.

bye.text: "Go dance it off." She's already reading the next hand at the rail.

vip.text: "Upstairs?" She tips her head at the rope. "That's Bishop's call, not mine. See the man on the door about a band. Once you've got one, the stair knows you — and up there they pour things I'm not allowed to say out loud down here."

menu.text: "Signature's the Voltage — looks like the drop, hits like it too. Neon martini if you want to look like you know what you're doing. Plasma shot if you've given up on that. Or a static fizz and you might actually remember tonight." She shrugs. "Your funeral, your money."

root.text: "Hey." Rue doesn't stop moving. "You want the board, or you want me to just look at you and decide?" A glass lands in front of you, empty, an invitation. "Talk fast, it's loud in here."

clothing_layers: a sleeveless black bodysuit with a hairline of blue light down each seam
a single conductive-thread cuff feeding the comms bud at her ear
high black boots and nothing that isn't deliberate

name: Rue Castellan
